newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT-NYMEX crude and unleaded poised to move up.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-NYMEX crude and unleaded poised to move up.

text.p: NEARBY MONTH CLOSE * SUPPORT * RESIST * RSI-14 * MA-10 * MA-20
* The trends are intact and the convergence of the five- and 15-day moving averages is very positive.

* Front month WTI is going to bump up against the long term downtrend very soon at $20.74. Given that the market rallied on the back of a poor set of API figures, then there is clearly a lot of underlying buying pressure -- probably sufficient to cause a break.
NYMEX crude and unleaded look poised to move higher again today with technical indicators looking very positive despite "high RSIs and toppy stochastics", analysts said.
"The trends are intact and the convergence of the five- and 15- day moving averages is very positive," said Charles Gray, analyst at Prudential-Bache International Limited.
"Stochastics and RSIs although high are not signalling a turnaround," Gray added. He said "A move through $20.50 could spark a fast move to $20.85 a barrel".

GNI Research said in their daily report: "Front month WTI is going to bump up against the long term downtrend very soon at $20.74. Given that the market rallied on the back of a poor set of API figures, then there is clearly a lot of underlying buying pressure -- probably sufficient to cause a break.
Analyst said the ultimate long term target remains the $22.40 high of May 16 but first the market must stay convincingly above $20.
Unleaded gasoline uptrend of the week remains intact but analysts said there were a few more barriers to be broken down before the longer term target of 67.60 cents from May 23 will come into view.
"The unleaded move to close above the highs of the last three-weeks is constructive, but it needs to get through the 40-day moving average first," Gray said.

Heating oil is still edging towards the crest of its fourth wave in uptrend since its fall from 75.70 cents a gallon down to 52.15 cents, but Wednesday narrow trading range formed a long legged Doji candlestick pattern on the spot month continuation chart which could be a signal the wave is about to break.
"The preparation is neutral so look to buy the dips to 54.20 cents or if the strength continues even 54.80 and cover shorts at 55.65 of a selling extreme," Fenella Graham at MeesPierson said.
